CZ banking trade press carrying appointments, partnerships and pilots — the narrative layer linking signals to named programmes.

Single dated ministry press release on the terminal-subsidy extension; valuable evidence, but monitor the MPO parent instead.
First-party bank press room with dated pricing, terminal/gateway and partnership announcements; replicate per bank.
Merchant-end trade portal with occasional relevant interviews; weak-signal colour, low yield relative to effort.
Regional CEE fintech agenda where CZ actors announce; useful but geographically peripheral to the CZ cell.
Leading CZ business daily reporting large IT/bank tenders, bidder counts, cancellations and UOHS disputes; core tender-narrative source.
